doctrine: Comprehensive operating system for Sniped Media: visual systems studio for LA founders built on engineering discipline, not inspiration. Core frameworks: Direction Stack (10-protocol system for mechanical/psychological posture failure modes), Visual Infrastructure Board (VIB: diagnostic contrast tool pairing weak existing photo against Sniped standard), Taste vs. Meal architecture (free studio time gated into paid gallery unlocks via 48-hour Pixieset expiration). Revenue model: Three tiers starting at $275 (Sprint), $550 (Standard), $1,500+ (Founder Reset). Free work categorized as strategic acquisition: Collab Free (audience 30K+, mandatory IG tag, $250 upsell), Community Free (cultural gravity from local institutions/leaders), Access Free (status from events/promoters). Positioning: operator-engineer applying data center rigor to visual trust. Platform split locked: LinkedIn=business authority (Direction Stack posts, founder audits, operator stories), Instagram=taste gallery (B&W cards, editorial restraint, no sales copy). Studio as character built via tethered psychology, BTS documentation, environmental curation. Commercial licensing layer: $500-$1,500 per image for brand reuse. Pricing justified not by time but by perception/trust/risk-mitigation (founder's weak visual presence costs them boardroom credibility). Weekly operating cadence: Monday pipeline sweep, Tuesday VIB sprint (3 boards), Wednesday content batching (3 LinkedIn posts), Thursday brand outreach, Friday delivery/studio prep, Saturday execution (stack shoots back-to-back for network overlap effect), Sunday system review. Lead pipeline: Target -> Engaged -> Deposit/Locked -> Shot -> Proofs Sent -> Retouching -> Delivered/Upsell -> Closed. CRM via Notion, booking via Calendly, delivery via Pixieset, comms via Gmail. 3-2-1 backup protocol non-negotiable (SD card to SSD+Cloud before formatting). Post-shoot protocol: Day 0 verbal anchor on tether, Day 1 deliver 1 hero free image + locked gallery link, Day 2 verify social post, Day 3 voice note referral ask, Day 14 check for brand reuse (trigger commercial license pitch), Day 90 quarterly refresh retainer pitch. Cull hierarchy: Mechanical posture (Direction Stack pass) -> Aesthetic standard (Sniped clinical pass) -> Variety (crop distribution) -> Platform utility (vertical/horizontal/overlay). Cutoff at 10-15 per look, deliver 30-45 proofs, client selects within tier limit, 48-hour expiration, $80/image overages auto-charged via Pixieset. VIB outreach: identify LA founder with trigger event (funding/press/speaking/rebrand), screenshot weak LinkedIn photo, build side-by-side contrast in Figma, send DM naming specific protocol failure, request 10-min discovery, close $1,500 Reset on call. Retainer pitch for brands: quarterly $1,500/mo for 1 session + 20 monthly assets via AI pipeline. Anti-rules locked: no price below $1,500 for Reset, no Direction Stack public launch before Q3, no second offer development, no website beyond landing page, no paid ads, no hiring beyond lead sourcer, no CRM switching, no 'researching' as procrastination. Broader ecosystem: Lion Group parent company holding four distinct pillars (Sniped Media=B2B cash engine, Meridian=cinematic/documentary arm, Wonderhouse=animation/IP, Lion Tech=software/utility). Sniped is revenue furnace funding cultural projects. Personal brand as operator/engineer bridges field engineering (100% uptime, fail-safes) to visual culture. Intellectual assets: Direction Stack manual (private PDF for clients), VIB proprietary diagnostic, essays on Visual Infrastructure/Operational Gap, eventual cloth-bound physical book (100 copies, gift 50 to network, sell 50). Long-term thesis: visual presence is business infrastructure, not art. 12-month roadmap phases: Phase 1 (30 days) System Lock, Phase 2 (months 2-3) Cash Engine via VIBs, Phase 3 (months 4-6) Network Node via overlap effect, Phase 4 (months 7-9) IP Incubation while Sniped runs efficiently, Phase 5 (months 10-12) Authority/Empire Transition. Monthly scorecard: VIBs Deployed / Discovery Calls Booked / Studio Hours / Upsell Conversion % / Cash Collected. Full-time job constraint = 9-12 hours/week maximum for Sniped (weekend shoots, 2-hour weeknight windows). Survival priority: Do not become free photographer. Gate all output, enforce boundaries, maintain perceived scarcity.

workflows: VIB Creation Workflow: Identify founder with trigger event -> Screenshot weak LinkedIn photo -> Figma VIB template (unaltered left, Sniped standard right) -> Send DM with protocol diagnosis -> Calendar link -> Discovery call -> Reset package close

Shoot-to-Delivery Workflow: Pre-shoot briefing (24hr) -> Tethered capture with verbal anchor -> Post-shoot cloud backup (3-2-1 protocol) -> Lightroom AI cull -> Operator manual cull to 10-15 per look -> Proofs upload to Pixieset (30-45 total) -> 48-hour expiration + gallery link email -> Client selects -> Retouch selects only -> Final delivery via clean Pixieset gallery -> Archive to Google Drive

Free Collab Workflow: Invite model/MUA (30K+ audience or strategic R&D) -> Pre-shoot boundary email (1 hero free, rest gated) -> Shoot tethered -> Cull and deliver 1 hero image Day 1 -> Email: 'Post this + Collab tag, rest in vault for $250 unlock' -> Enforce Day 2 social post check -> Day 3 referral ask voice note -> Track $250 upsell conversion

Community Visibility Workflow: Identify local leader (coach/restaurant owner/theater director/barber) -> Pitch free 30-min portrait in studio -> Deliver 3-5 clinical portraits, printed + digital -> Ask for intro to board/alumni/donor network -> Track conversions to $1,500 founder resets from that network

Event/Access Free Workflow: Secure all-access pass to promoter show -> Shoot operators/VIPs/environment (not crowd) -> Cull to 20-30 best shots by 10 AM next day -> Deliver via Pixieset with usage terms footer -> Monitor Instagram for brand reposts -> Send Commercial Licensing invoice if third-party use detected -> Pitch quarterly retainer to promoter

LinkedIn Authority Workflow: Sunday evening batch write 3 posts (Mechanical Audit / Engineering Bridge / Direction Stack Protocol Deep Dive) -> Schedule M/W/F at 8 AM -> Daily: 5 connection requests, 5 operator-level comments, 5 min DM clearing -> Thursday: build 3 VIBs in Figma, send outreach DMs -> Track discovery call conversion rate

Client Inquiry to Invoice Workflow: Inbound DM asking rates -> Auto-reply: 'Calendly link to 10-min discovery call' -> Call: diagnose visual gap using Direction Stack -> Send proposal + Stripe invoice link -> 50% deposit required to lock date -> Confirm email with studio address + wardrobe rules -> Locked in calendar

Gallery Upsell Automation Workflow: Client selects N images (within tier limit) -> If N exceeds tier, Pixieset cart auto-calculates $80/image overages -> Send invoice automatically -> Client pays or doesn't; no manual follow-up required

Commercial Licensing Detection Workflow: Every delivered image watermarked initially -> Monitor client's IG/LinkedIn weekly for 30 days post-delivery -> If third-party brand reposts, find marketing director -> Send Commercial Licensing email: 'Noticed [Brand] is using image from [Event]. Standard rate for commercial social is $X. Invoice attached.'

Weekly Pipeline Maintenance: Sunday evening open Notion CRM -> Audit every active lead has Next Action Date -> Move completed actions left-to-right in Kanban -> Identify dead leads, move to 'Closed (Dead)' -> VIBs Deployed count -> Discovery Calls Booked count -> Cash Collected amount -> Preview next week's locked shoots

contradictions: Tension between 'free work builds reputation' and 'free work makes you the free photographer'. Resolved by: strict categories (Collab Free = audience reach, Community Free = cultural nodes only, Access Free = status venues only) + gating final deliverables (1 free hero, rest $250 unlock). Not contradiction if systems are enforced.

Tension between 'I shoot high-volume on set' (300 photos) and 'I deliver curated not overwhelming' (30-45 proofs). Resolved by: high volume is for ON-SET energy + psychology, but post-production cull is ruthless and non-negotiable.

Tension between 'Saturday-only shooting' for mental health vs. 'full-time job exhaustion' making even Saturdays hard. Resolved by: only 1-2 shoots per Saturday max, stacked back-to-back to create network overlap effect; weeknights reserved for editing only (no additional shoots).

Tension between 'premium $1,500+ positioning' and 'entry-level $275 Sprint tier'. Resolved by: $1,500 is anchor that makes $275 look accessible; $275 is trapping funnel, not business model. Goal is eventually phase out $275 once Reset demand locks 3+ weeks out.

Tension between 'no website overbuilding' and 'premium perception requires professional digital presence'. Resolved by: one-page Carrd/Squarespace with intake form is enough; VIB outreach converts faster than perfect website anyway.

Tension between 'Lion Group ecosystem' (Meridian, Wonderhouse, Tech) being fully architected but 'Sniped is the only focus for 12 months'. Resolved by: ecosystem is intellectually locked but operationally in stealth; Sniped is the cash engine that will eventually fund the broader projects.

Tension between 'commercial licensing layer is major revenue' and 'most free/collab work won't convert to licensing'. Resolved by: not all free work converts; the Access Free (events/venues) tier is where licensing revenue concentrates; track this separately.
weird_gold: Tethered psychology as primary differentiator: showing subject their own premium image live-time on a monitor collapses imposter syndrome and changes their posture for the rest of the session. This is not standard in photography; it's a psychological lever.
The 48-hour Pixieset expiration timer as sales mechanism: removes need to manually upsell; creates urgency automatically; client's own FOMO sells the gallery unlock. Pure automation of the close.

The VIB (Visual Infrastructure Board) as diagnostic X-ray: presenting a founder with their own weak LinkedIn photo side-by-side with a Sniped reference frame makes the gap undeniable. They sell themselves.

Direction Stack as philosophy, not just technique: reframing photography as a 10-protocol system of mechanical/psychological failure modes converts the work from 'art' to 'engineering.' This positioning shields against AI disruption.

The 'Taste vs. Meal' framing: separating time (free taste, the vibe, the experience) from deliverables (gated meal, the final images) allows free work to exist without devaluing the business. Genius framework.

Collab post control by photographer: the model gets ONE free image and MUST tag you in a Collab post, but you write the caption and frame the presentation. You control how you're perceived in their 50K audience.
Founder-as-target over generic instagrammers: most photographers chase followers; Sniped Media hunts founders with $1M+ businesses and $200K budgets. Completely different velocity of conversion.

Studio as character/ecosystem play: instead of 'book a shoot,' the studio becomes a nexus where a 50K model overlaps with a tech founder in the waiting room, and you broker the introduction. Network density becomes the product.

The 'Operator' lexicon ownership: clinical terminology (Visual Infrastructure, Direction Stack, Mechanical Posture, Engineered Excellence) becomes proprietary language that crowds out generic photographer speak and establishes category ownership.

12-month phase structure: Phase 1 locks systems, Phase 2 proves unit economics, Phase 3 builds network density, Phase 4 quietly incubates IP while Phase 5 shows profit. The sequencing prevents burnout and allows each layer to fund the next.

Post-shoot Day 90 retainer pitch: most photographers never follow up; the system flags 90 days out for founders/brands who have now deployed imagery multiple times and proven the value. Conversion at highest intent point.

Commercial licensing footer on event galleries: by including usage terms, you've legally documented the distinction between organic social and commercial use. When a brand reposts, you have a paper trail for the invoice.
The rejection filter: 'I don't shoot weddings / events / X category' immediately signals premium positioning and operates as a paradoxical magnet (people want access to selective operators).

Field Engineer positioning as unfair advantage: creatives are expected to be emotional and chaotic; engineers are expected to be systematic and bulletproof. Applying engineer rigor to visual work creates a category of one.

Lion Group parent architecture: keeping the umbrella company invisible while the subsidiaries (Sniped, Meridian, Wonderhouse) operate publicly allows future IP expansion without confusing the Sniped Media pitch or diluting brand equity.
notes: This Gemini thread represents a complete strategic operating system for a creative business built by an engineer. The artifact was created through iterative, conversational refinement with Google Gemini AI and contains 15 distinct strategic prompts + corresponding comprehensive responses. The thread moves from positioning/branding (Prompts 1-2) through operations/workflows (Prompts 3-8) through ecosystem thinking (Prompts 9-10) and final readiness audit. The intelligence is unusual: it applies data-center engineering rigor (100% uptime, fail-safes, systematic design) to visual culture and personal branding. Core thesis: visual presence is business infrastructure, not art. Positioning is 'Operator' (peer to founders) not 'Vendor' (hired help). The work documents 7+ years of constraint-based learning (one-light apartment shoots, garage studios, borrowed spaces) and applies those lessons at scale in a real LA studio. Notable intellectual property: Direction Stack (10-protocol system for diagnosing mechanical/psychological failure modes on camera), Visual Infrastructure Board (VIB: diagnostic contrast tool), Taste vs. Meal framework (separating free time from gated deliverables). Revenue model is three-tier ladder ($275 / $550 / $1,500+) with free work strategized into three categories (Collab Free / Community Free / Access Free) and priced justification rooted in perception/trust rather than time-tracking. The broader Lion Group ecosystem vision (holding Sniped Media, Meridian film production, Wonderhouse animation, Lion Tech software) is intellectually locked but operationally deferred. The plan prioritizes ruthless execution of the cash engine (Sniped) over building empire before proof. This is high-signal because it synthesizes engineering systems thinking, actual photography/studio operations, B2B sales psychology, LA cultural knowledge, HBCU/Greek network dynamics, and long-term intellectual property strategy into one coherent machine. No filler. All frameworks are repeatable and stress-tested against the constraint of working full-time while building on weekends/nights. The writing tone is clinical, unsentimental, operator-level. Delivers actionable checklists, SOPs, scripts, and metrics. Avoids motivational speak entirely. Final audit section shows readiness to move from planning to execution.
